title: Seawatch and Reef Guardian Surveillance Coordination
summary: This community involves coordinated surveillance efforts between Seawatch and Reef Guardian, focusing on monitoring Nemo Reef. Key communications indicate plans for a patrol in the eastern quadrant, emphasizing the need for documentation of vessel registration numbers.
rating explanation: The impact severity rating reflects potential risks related to undetected activities at Nemo Reef due to ongoing surveillance and data documentation needs.
